I will buy a small bag of chemical fertilizer because I have seen that it helps the rice grow better, but I cannot afford too much since I have no schooling and must watch my costs carefully. I will use seed from my own storage that I kept from last season, and my family will do most of the work planting, weeding, and harvesting, though I may hire a few day laborers when the harvest is heavy.
